mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_document (user_id, title, source_type, city, content, chunk_count, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{sourceType}, #{city}, #{content}, #{chunkCount}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kb_document WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1

SELECT id, user_id, title, source_type, city, chunk_count, status, create_time, update_time FROM kb_document WHERE status = 1
AND source_type = #{sourceType}
AND (city = #{city} OR city IS NULL OR city = '')
ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_document SET chunk_count = #{chunkCount} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE kb_document SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
